About this item

  • GERMAN STAINLESS STEEL KNIFE SET – 17-piece professional knife block set features premium blades stamped from German stainless steel for rust resistance, long-lasting sharpness*, and all-purpose kitchen performance. *When used/maintained as directed.
  • RAZOR-SHARP PRECISION CUTTING – Ultra-sharp blades with an optimized cutting angle glide effortlessly through meat, vegetables, and crusty bread — making chopping, slicing, and dicing fast and precise.
  • ERGONOMIC, COMFORTABLE GRIP – Chef-approved, perfectly balanced handle design for professional weight distribution, control, and fatigue-free cutting comfort all day long.
  • NEVERDULL TECHNOLOGY BUILT-IN SHARPENER – Exclusive NeverDull Technology is integrated directly into the knife block, delivering professional-grade sharpening results that maintain a razor-sharp edge for up to 10 years* — no additional sharpener needed. *When used/maintained as directed.
  • FOOLPROOF SELF-SHARPENING IN SECONDS – By simply swiping the lever on the outside of the block; the dynamic ceramic sharpening wheel engages your blade at the perfect angle with optimal pressure to restore optimal sharpness.
  • PREMIUM STAMPED STEAK KNIVES INCLUDED – Entertain with confidence — 8 stamped German stainless steel steak knives deliver steakhouse-quality cuts through any meat without tearing, so every dinner feels like a five-star experience.
  • SLEEK COUNTERTOP KNIFE BLOCK – Modern block with brushed stainless-steel accents stores all 17 pieces safely and stylishly, complementing any kitchen aesthetic from minimalist to contemporary — all within easy countertop reach.
  • COMPLETE 17-PIECE SET – Includes 8" Chef, 8" Bread, 7" Santoku, 8" Slicing, 6" Boning, 5" Utility, 3.5" Paring knives, 8 Steak knives, Kitchen Shears, and NeverDull knife block — everything a home chef needs in one set.

Product Description

Meet the Ninja™ NeverDull® Premium Knife System, the premium knives that stay razor-sharp for up to 10 years*. Designed for home chefs who demand professional-grade performance, this 17-piece knife block set combines stamped German stainless-steel precision with groundbreaking NeverDull® Technology to help keep blades razor-sharp for up to 10 years*. Each knife features durable German quality stainless-steel blades — rust-resistant, professional, and sharpened to a precision cutting angle that glides effortlessly through meat, vegetables, herbs, and crusty bread. The ergonomic, chef-approved handle delivers perfect balance and fatigue-free control, so every cut feels effortless. What sets this system apart is the built-in NeverDull® sharpener integrated directly into the block. No separate tools, no guesswork — with swipes of the lever, and the dynamic ceramic sharpening wheel automatically engages your blade at the perfect angle, applying optimal pressure to restore a professional edge in seconds. Complete your kitchen with 8 stamped steak knives that cut through meat like a steakhouse pro, plus a sleek, modern block with stainless steel accents that looks as good on your countertop as it performs. *when used/maintained as directed

    5 out of 5 stars
    I love this knife set
    Reviewed in the United States on December 3, 2025
    Size: 17-Piece
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I ordered the Ninja Foodi NeverDull 17-piece knife set because I was tired of constantly switching between dull knives and cheap replacements. After using this set for a while in an everyday home-kitchen setting, here’s what I’ve honestly found:

    Right away, the set feels solid and well-made compared to my old Mainstays Knife Set that's over 10 years old.

    Each knife has a nice weight to it — not too heavy, not flimsy — and the handles feel comfortable even when I’m doing longer prep work. The German stainless steel definitely feels a step up from the random mixed knives I had before. They cut really well. The chef’s knife is probably the one I have used the most, and it slices through vegetables and meat cleanly without me having to “saw” through anything. The steak knives are also surprisingly sharp.

    The built-in sharpener is honestly one of my favorite parts. You literally slide the knife through the sharpener on the block and it freshens the edge. It’s easy, it takes seconds, and it keeps the knives very sharp.

    One thing to note: they’re not dishwasher safe. That didn’t bother me too much because I hand-wash my better kitchen tools anyway, but it’s definitely something to be aware of if you prefer to just toss everything in the dishwasher.

    There’s a knife for pretty much everything. This set has way more than I actually use day-to-day, but it’s nice knowing I have a bread knife, a boning knife, and plenty of steak knives when I need them. It feels like the kind of set that covers you for almost any home cooking situation.

    Only con for me is the amount of counter space they take up, compared to my old set. So, if you have a smaller kitchen you’ll want to think about where it’s going to sit. But the block looks nice and modern, so I don’t mind it being on my counter top next to my stove.

    All in all, they are definitely a solid upgrade.

    I’m really impressed with this Ninja NeverDull knife set. The knives feel sturdy, balanced, and comfortable to use, and they make everyday prep so much easier. I also love that they feel nice, not too heavy. From chopping vegetables to slicing bread or carving meat, there is a knife for just about everything... I got the 17 piece set haha.. a little bit of a Ninja fan! :P and including eight steak knives and kitchen shears makes the most of this set.

    My favorite feature is the sharpener built into the block. It is incredibly convenient and takes the guesswork out of keeping the blades sharp. Just a quick use of the sharpener helps restore the edge, so the knives continue to cut smoothly instead of crushing food. The black block also looks clean and modern on the counter.

    Overall, this is a great all-in-one set for anyone who wants sharp, reliable knives without the hassle of separate sharpening tools. Ninja says its built-in NeverDull sharpener is designed to maintain a sharp edge for more than 10 years.. guess I'll let you know in 10 years it that's true! :P

About this Item

  • GERMAN STAINLESS STEEL KNIFE SET – 17-piece professional knife block set features premium blades stamped from German stainless steel for rust resistance, long-lasting sharpness*, and all-purpose kitchen performance. *When used/maintained as directed.
  • RAZOR-SHARP PRECISION CUTTING – Ultra-sharp blades with an optimized cutting angle glide effortlessly through meat, vegetables, and crusty bread — making chopping, slicing, and dicing fast and precise.
  • ERGONOMIC, COMFORTABLE GRIP – Chef-approved, perfectly balanced handle design for professional weight distribution, control, and fatigue-free cutting comfort all day long.
  • NEVERDULL TECHNOLOGY BUILT-IN SHARPENER – Exclusive NeverDull Technology is integrated directly into the knife block, delivering professional-grade sharpening results that maintain a razor-sharp edge for up to 10 years* — no additional sharpener needed. *When used/maintained as directed.
  • FOOLPROOF SELF-SHARPENING IN SECONDS – By simply swiping the lever on the outside of the block; the dynamic ceramic sharpening wheel engages your blade at the perfect angle with optimal pressure to restore optimal sharpness.
  • PREMIUM STAMPED STEAK KNIVES INCLUDED – Entertain with confidence — 8 stamped German stainless steel steak knives deliver steakhouse-quality cuts through any meat without tearing, so every dinner feels like a five-star experience.
  • SLEEK COUNTERTOP KNIFE BLOCK – Modern block with brushed stainless-steel accents stores all 17 pieces safely and stylishly, complementing any kitchen aesthetic from minimalist to contemporary — all within easy countertop reach.
  • COMPLETE 17-PIECE SET – Includes 8" Chef, 8" Bread, 7" Santoku, 8" Slicing, 6" Boning, 5" Utility, 3.5" Paring knives, 8 Steak knives, Kitchen Shears, and NeverDull knife block — everything a home chef needs in one set.

Product Description

Meet the Ninja™ NeverDull® Premium Knife System, the premium knives that stay razor-sharp for up to 10 years*. Designed for home chefs who demand professional-grade performance, this 17-piece knife block set combines stamped German stainless-steel precision with groundbreaking NeverDull® Technology to help keep blades razor-sharp for up to 10 years*. Each knife features durable German quality stainless-steel blades — rust-resistant, professional, and sharpened to a precision cutting angle that glides effortlessly through meat, vegetables, herbs, and crusty bread. The ergonomic, chef-approved handle delivers perfect balance and fatigue-free control, so every cut feels effortless. What sets this system apart is the built-in NeverDull® sharpener integrated directly into the block. No separate tools, no guesswork — with swipes of the lever, and the dynamic ceramic sharpening wheel automatically engages your blade at the perfect angle, applying optimal pressure to restore a professional edge in seconds. Complete your kitchen with 8 stamped steak knives that cut through meat like a steakhouse pro, plus a sleek, modern block with stainless steel accents that looks as good on your countertop as it performs. *when used/maintained as directed
